answer_1.quote: We present a pipeline to create a synthetic dataset (TGQA) for question answering that requires TR.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include temporal graphs, reasoning chains (CoTs), and answers to temporal reasoning questions.

answer_2.quote: We thoroughly evaluate our framework on all the datasets with a combination of the metrics, i.e., token-level F1, exact match (EM) and perplexity-based accuracy (Acc).

answer_3.quote: To address this problem, we propose a semi-automatic verification method. Fully manual inspection is expensive, but by first utilizing LLM we can narrow down potential errors, and only manually inspect the set of unanswered questions by LLM.

answer_4.quote: Furthermore, inspired by , we manually check 100 CoTs generated by different strategies (Table ). Evaluators are asked to classify the errors into four types (using wrong info, logical inconsistency, external knowledge error, and temporal graph error).
